commands.name: unit
commands.command: TURBO_TEST_MODE=unit pnpm exec turbo run test --summarize --log-order=grouped --concurrency=2

commands.name: desktop-regression
commands.command: cd apps/desktop && pnpm exec playwright test --project=regression --workers=1 --grep-invert "@desktop-embedding-"

commands.name: affected-coverage
commands.command: TURBO_TEST_MODE=coverage COVERAGE=true pnpm exec turbo run test:coverage --filter="...[39f9a7106c9d0af99a668f4119efb5163f5ceb17]" --concurrency=4 --summarize --log-order=grouped
